patterns.note: A dual sticky navigation system is employed, featuring a persistent icon-based left sidebar alongside a traditional top navigation bar.
Content sections alternate between full-width white and light grey backgrounds, with a prominent full-width dark blue section used to highlight a key value proposition.
Large, bold sans-serif headings introduce each major content section, creating clear visual hierarchy and strong focal points.
A consistent brand blue is used for all primary calls-to-action, key headings, and a full-bleed background section, reinforcing brand identity throughout the page.
The main header navigation bar subtly transforms on scroll, reducing its height and removing its shadow to optimize vertical space as the user scrolls down.
A persistent left-hand icon navigation remains fixed in the viewport, providing continuous access to core features regardless of scroll depth.

technique_notes: The main content area scrolls vertically, while a top navigation bar and a left-hand icon navigation remain fixed in place. The top bar subtly condenses and loses its shadow after the initial scroll to save space.

Content is organized into distinct, full-width horizontal sections, often with alternating background colors to visually separate them. Within these sections, content is typically centered or arranged in a two-column layout with text on one side and an image or cards on the other.
Information is presented in a grid of cards for features and testimonials, using subtle rounded corners and soft shadows to give them a sense of depth and separation from the background.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (approx. 2-3x body text) with clear, readable body text and smaller, functional labels for supporting information.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) applied consistently to buttons, cards, and image containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within the hero, becoming denser in feature grids and footers.

standout: The most distinctive design element is the dual sticky navigation system, which combines a traditional top bar with a persistent, icon-based left-hand sidebar. This provides a unique and efficient way to navigate core site features while maintaining a clean main content area, setting it apart from typical single-navigation layouts.
